sn2.29:7.1: atha kho susīmassa devaputtassa devaputtaparisā āyasmato sāriputtassa vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attamanā pamuditā pītisomanassajātā uccāvacā vaṇṇanibhā upadaṃseti.
sn2.29:8.1: seyyathāpi nāma maṇiveḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato paṇḍukambale nikkhitto bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
sn2.29:8.2: evamevaṃ susīmassa devaputtassa devaputtaparisā āyasmato sāriputtassa vaṇṇe bhaññamāne attamanā pamuditā pītisomanassajātā uccāvacā vaṇṇanibhā upadaṃseti.
sn2.29:9.1: seyyathāpi nāma nekkhaṃ jambonadaṃ dakkhakammāraputtena ukkāmukhe sukusalasampahaṭṭhaṃ paṇḍukambale nikkhittaṃ bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
sn2.29:9.2: evamevaṃ susīmassa devaputtassa devaputtaparisā …pe… uccāvacā vaṇṇanibhā upadaṃseti.
sn2.29:10.1: seyyathāpi nāma [saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve] rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ osadhitārakā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
sn2.29:10.2: evamevaṃ susīmassa devaputtassa devaputtaparisā …pe… uccāvacā vaṇṇanibhā upadaṃseti.
sn2.29:11.1: seyyathāpi nāma saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussukkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamaṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
sn2.29:11.2: evamevaṃ susīmassa devaputtassa devaputtaparisā …pe… uccāvacā vaṇṇanibhā upadaṃseti.
